faq.title: Everything You Need to Know
faq.subtitle: Complete transparency regarding collaboration models, milestone payments, delivery timelines, and AI reliability.
faq.stillQuestions: Have a specific project or questions?
faq.askDirectly: Book a 30-minute discovery call or drop me an email.

items.q: How do you handle pricing and contracts?
items.a: I work with transparent contracts structured around verifiable milestones. Typically, this involves an upfront deposit of 30-40% at project start, intermediate payments upon delivery of agreed modules, and the final balance upon acceptance. All work is formally invoiced with a detailed, fixed quote agreed upon in advance—no hidden costs.

items.q: What is the typical project timeline?
items.a: For a complete MVP, enterprise portal, or custom management dashboard, average delivery time is 3 to 5 weeks. For targeted AI automation (e.g. document OCR pipelines or intelligent agents), working testable prototypes are ready in 7 to 14 days. I operate in weekly agile sprints with continuous live demos for full visibility.

items.q: How do you ensure AI accuracy and scalability?
items.a: Thanks to official Anthropic Claude training, I apply a 'deterministic-first' architecture: LLM outputs (Claude, Gemini) are validated against strict data schemas (e.g. Zod, JSON Schema) and paired with specialized OCR preprocessors. This drastically reduces the risk of hallucinations and pushes accuracy above 99% in tested cases. Serverless or Docker-based deployment guarantees seamless scaling under load.

items.q: Who owns the source code and intellectual property?
items.a: Upon final balance, 100% of the source code, deployment setups, and intellectual property belong exclusively to your company. You receive full Git repository access, architecture documentation, and complete operational independence without vendor lock-in or recurring license fees.

items.q: What does post-launch support look like?
items.a: Every project includes a 30-day warranty and free technical support window for bug fixes or operational questions. Afterward, flexible ongoing maintenance agreements and on-demand feature development are available to ensure the longevity of your software.

The fastest way is to book a 30-minute discovery call via Calendly (use the button below). We will discuss your goals, requirements, and technical constraints. Within 48 hours, I will send you a detailed technical and financial proposal with a roadmap and milestone timeline.
